Cornelis (Kees) Vuik ([[Capelle aan den IJssel]], Jan. 25, 1959) is a Dutch [[mathematician]] and emeritus professor. In 1982 he received his master's degree in [[applied mathematics]] from [[Delft University of Technology]] in [[Netherlands]]. He worked at [[Philips Natuurkundig Laboratorium]] for six months. He completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] at [[Utrecht University]] in 1988. His research<ref>{{Cite book |last=Vuik |first=C. |url=https://ir.cwi.nl/pub/13211 |title=The solution of a one-dimensional Stefan problem |date=1993-01-01 |isbn=978-90-6196-419-3 |language=en}}</ref> focused on moving-boundary problems (Stefan problems) and he was supervised by Prof. dr. E.M.J. Bertin and Prof. dr. A. van der Sluis.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Cornelis Vuik - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=51007 |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> Vuik then worked at [[Delft University of Technology|TU Delft]], successively as assistant professor, associate professor, and eventually full professor of [[Numerical analysis|Numerical Analysis]] (2007-2026) in the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Inaugural lecture page of Kees Vuik |url=http://homepage.tudelft.nl/d2b4e/talks/inaug_eng.html |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=homepage.tudelft.nl}}</ref> From 2022-2025, he served as chair of the Delft Institute of Applied Mathematics (DIAM) department.<ref>{{Cite web |title=New Chair Delft Institute of Applied Mathematics (DIAM) |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2022/eemcs/new-chair-delft-institute-of-applied-mathematics-diam |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=en-US}}</ref>
[[File:Vuik 2025.jpg|thumb|Kees Vuik]]

== Research ==
Vuik's primary research interests are in [[numerical linear algebra]]. He also works on simulators for energy networks and high-performance computing.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Research page of Kees Vuik |url=http://homepage.tudelft.nl/d2b4e/research.html |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=homepage.tudelft.nl}}</ref> Several dozen Ph.D. students have been supervised by Vuik.<ref name=":0" /> His research has led to many publications in international journals.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Publications of C. Vuik |url=https://research.tudelft.nl/en/persons/c-vuik/publications |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft Research Portal |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Google Scholar page of Kees Vuik |url=https://scholar.google.nl/citations?user=P7k6VuEAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=scholar.google.nl}}</ref> He was the founder of the TU Delft Institute for Computational Science and Engineering (DCSE), of which he has been the director from 2007 to 2025<ref>{{Cite web |title=Matthias Möller new Scientific Director of the TU Delft Institute for Computational Science and Engineering |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2025/eemcs/matthias-moller-new-scientific-director-of-the-tu-delft-institute-for-computational-science-and-engineering}}</ref>. The institute connects TU Delft researchers from various disciplines that make use of computational methods. Thanks to his efforts, a High-Performance Computing facility was created within [[Delft University of Technology|TU Delft]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=TU Delft supercomputer officially opened |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2022/tu-delft/tu-delft-supercomputer-officially-opened |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=en-US}}</ref> to which he has been a scientific director from 2020 to 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DHPC staff |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/dhpc/people |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=nl-NL |archive-date=2023-08-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230815122204/https://www.tudelft.nl/dhpc/people |url-status=dead }}</ref> From 2012 to 2019, Vuik also served as scientific director of the 4TU.Applied Mathematics Institute<ref>{{Cite web |title=4TU Applied Mathematics Institute |url=https://www.4tu.nl/ami/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=Applied Mathematics Institute |language=en}}</ref> (4TU.AMI) of [[Delft University of Technology|TU Delft]], [[Eindhoven University of Technology|TU Eindhoven]], the [[University of Twente]] and [[Wageningen University & Research]]. Under his leadership, the institute has grown into an important player within the Dutch mathematical community, with connections to similar institutes such as Matheon in Berlin.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Collaboration 4TU.AMI and Matheon |url=https://www.4tu.nl/ami/News/News/matheon-collaboration/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=Applied Mathematics Institute |language=en}}</ref> 4TU.AMI has also contributed to the innovation of mathematics education.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Blended learning project ends |url=https://www.4tu.nl/ami/News/News/blended-learning-ends/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=Applied Mathematics Institute |language=en}}</ref> In 2013, Vuik participated in a Flemish-Dutch economic mission to Texas as a representative of (at the time) the 3TU federation.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2013-07-02 |title=Joint Dutch-Flemish economic mission to Texas |url=https://www.government.nl/latest/news/2013/07/02/joint-dutch-flemish-economic-mission-to-texas |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=www.government.nl |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Netherlands-Flanders Economic Mission to Texas - PDF Free Download |url=https://docplayer.net/40440809-Netherlands-flanders-economic-mission-to-texas.html |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=docplayer.net}}</ref>

== Teaching ==
Vuik is active in developing mathematical courses, BSc. and MSc. curricula, and educational innovations. He founded the minor Computational Science and Engineering.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Minor Computational Science and Engineering |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/ewi/studeren/minoren/computational-science-and-engineering |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=nl-NL}}</ref> He is the coordinator of the international program Computer Simulation for Science and Engineering (COSSE), established in cooperation with [[Technical University of Berlin|TU Berlin]] and [[KTH Royal Institute of Technology|KTH Royal Institute of Technology Sweden]]. Vuik was also closely involved in the Massive Open Online Course (MOOC) Mathematical Modeling Basics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=MOOC: Modelling with Differential Equations {{!}} TU Delft Online |url=https://online-learning.tudelft.nl/courses/modelling-with-differential-equations/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft Online Learning |language=en}}</ref> Tens of thousands of students have already participated in this online course. Vuik is a faculty advisor of the SIAM Student Chapter Delft of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM). He is further involved in the development and application of Multi-Media Math Education (MUMIE), an open-source e-learning platform in mathematics.

== Awards ==
Vuik has won several awards throughout his career, including:

- 2026: [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] Fellow; <ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Announces 2026 Class of Fellows |url=https://www.siam.org/publications/siam-news/articles/siam-announces-2026-class-of-fellows/ |access-date=2026-07-27}}</ref>

- 2022: Professor of Excellence Award of the Delft University Fund;<ref>{{Cite web |title=Best Professor Award received by Kees Vuik |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2022/university-fund/best-professor-award-received-by-kees-vuik |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=en-US}}</ref>

- 2021: Officer in the Order of [[House of Orange-Nassau|Orange Nassau]];<ref>{{Cite web |title=Royal Honours for mathematician Kees Vuik |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2021/eemcs/royal-honours-for-mathematician-kees-vuik |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=en-US}}</ref>

- 2017: Bronze medal of the [[Delft University of Technology|TU Delft]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kees Vuik is honored with the bronze 'legpenning' |url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2017/ewi/kees-vuik-is-honored-with-the-bronze-legpenning |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=TU Delft |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Ancillary positions ==
Some of Vuik's ancillary positions are:

- Jury member of the [[ASML Holding|ASML]] graduation prize for mathematics at the [[Royal Holland Society of Sciences and Humanities]] (KHMW);

- Participant in the mathematics council of the Dutch Platform for Mathematics (PWN);<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Dutch Platform for Mathematics – PWN |url=https://platformwiskunde.nl/the-dutch-platform-for-mathematics/ |access-date=2023-03-22}}</ref>

- President-director of the Batavian Society of Experimental Philosophy;<ref>{{Cite web |title=Board of the Batavian Society |url=https://www.bataafschgenootschap.nl/over-het-genootschap/bestuur/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=Bataafsch Genootschap |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Appointed as president-director |url=https://www.linkedin.com/posts/tu-delft-electrical-engineering-mathematics-and-computer-science_bataafschgenootschap-bataafschgenootschapderproefondervindelijkewijsbegeerte-activity-7257744656371798016-SdXt/ |access-date=2025-02-10 |website=LinkedIn |language=en-US}}</ref> 

- Treasurer at EU-Maths-IN;<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=Executive Board of EU-Maths-IN |url=https://eu-maths-in.eu/executive-board/ |access-date=2022-11-04 |language=en-US}}</ref>

- Chairman of the local organizing committee of ICIAM 2027;<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kees Vuik {{!}} ICIAM |url=https://iciam.org/authors/kees-vuik |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=iciam.org |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Hague: Site of ICIAM 2027 {{!}} ICIAM |url=https://iciam.org/news/22/1/11/hague-site-iciam-2027 |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=iciam.org |language=en}}</ref>

- Member of the organizing committee of the SIAM Conference on Computational Science and Engineering in 2021<ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Conference on Computational Science and Engineering (CSE21) |url=https://www.siam.org/conferences/cm/conference/cse21 |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=SIAM |language=en-US}}</ref> and 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Conference on Computational Science and Engineering (CSE23) |url=https://www.siam.org/conferences/cm/conference/cse23 |access-date=2022-11-04 |website=SIAM |language=en-US}}</ref>
